sources.title: Staff at Grand Theft Auto maker Rockstar vote against union recognition deal
sources.text: Workers at Grand Theft Auto maker Rockstar Games have voted against a union recognition deal. 1,544 staff members took part in the vote across the company's locations in Edinburgh, Leeds, Lincoln, Dundee and London, representing a 93.2% turnout. Despite this huge engagement, 75.3% voted against Independent Workers of Great Britain (IWGB) union recognition, while 24.7% voted in favour. Had this vote gone the other way, IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union would have been the biggest recognised union in the UK games industry, and Rockstar would have been obligated to engage with collective bargaining on pay and working hours. "We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6," the company's head of publishing, Jennifer Kolbe, said in a statement. "This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together," said a company rep. IWGB says that Rockstar staff will keep organising regardless of whether the union is formally recognised. "For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society – this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for," the organisation said in its own statement. "Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognise we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We’re ready to put in the effort to make that happen. "Whilst we haven’t emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening. People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us. "A recognition agreement would have marked a path towards greater workplace democracy. But it’s one route of many. At Rockstar we have already won, and will continue to win, tangible changes that improve our everyday lives. We’ll keep fighting for a say. For pay transparency, contractual overtime pay, and protections against AI and layoffs. "The power to shape our working lives has always been, and will always be, in our hands." Under UK law, the union may not re-apply for recognition for three years, although staff remain free to join the RGWU. The question of forming a union at Rockstar Games followed allegations that 34 members of staff were let go from the Grand Theft Auto maker in a move that IWGB called union-busting . Rockstar parent company Take-Two has denied this claim, saying that staff were fired for "distributing and discussing confidential information". Rockstar and IWGB are currently embroiled in an employment tribunal regarding these job cuts; closing arguments were issued on November 19 . Judge Lucy Wiseman, who oversaw proceedings, said that there is no timeframe yet for the judgement, but said she would try her best to "get that judgement out as quickly as possible". Grand Theft Auto 6 launched on November 19th and made a record $3.79 billion in revenue in its first 24 hours on sale .

sources.text: Go to hell and get this health upgrade in GTA 6 You can find a permanent health upgrade and a hidden mission which sends you hell in GTA 6. This hidden mission takes players on a supernatural adventure where they travel to Hell, fight waves of demons and face Satan himself. Completing the encounter also unlocks exclusive rewards, including a powerful shotgun and a permanent health boost. If you’re wondering how to unlock the GTA 6 Hell mission, where to find it and how to defeat its final boss, here’s everything you need to know. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. To unlock the secret Hell mission, you must first reach Chapter 2 of the GTA 6 story. Once available, travel to northern Port Gellhorn between midnight and 4 AM in-game. Look for a yellow house with a red-lit garage and the words “Welcome to the Hell Hole” painted on its wall. Inside, you’ll find two metalheads named Beelzebub and Dave. Approach them and select the following dialogue options: Choose “Having Fun?” when interacting with the characters. Sit and have a beer with them while they chat to you. Select “It’s Good” when asked about the music. Wait for their friend Steve to arrive in a demon-themed van. When offered, speak to Dave and choose “Get In”. You’ll then travel to a remote campsite where a mysterious ritual takes place. Once you arrive at the campsite, approach the large bonfire. When prompted, hold L2 to stare into the fire.Â Jason or Lucia will eventually wake up in hell, where you’ll receive a shotgun and face several waves of demonic enemies.Follow the green portals to progress through the different areas until you reach the final boss arena. The enemies in hell will typically take two or three shots to take down. If you die during this sequence, you’ll have to start the mission again from the fire. In order to do this, use the “eat” prompt on the wooden throne near the fire. Defeating Satan, also known as the Pretender, requires more than simply shooting him. His health bar initially appears black, meaning he’s invulnerable. Instead, focus on eliminating the headless demons he summons. These enemies explode when killed, temporarily turning Satan’s health bar red. If they get to close to you and explode, they’ll usually kill you. When his health bar becomes red, immediately attack him with your shotgun. Repeat this strategy while avoiding exploding enemies and charging goats until the boss is defeated. Completing the Circles of Hell encounter unlocks several exclusive rewards: Remember to collect the Hellspawn Comshot 12 beside the wooden throne before leaving the campsite.

sources.text: Freddie Gibbs' apocalypse bunker is what will unlock Hurricanes for the first time in GTA 6 GTA 6 hurricanes are a weather phenomenon that only unlock through the questline about Freddie's Bunker - specifically, Freddie Gibbs, acclaimed rapper, who has built a prepper apocalypse bunker that he wants you to test the security measures for. This ultimately leads to a choice about whether you want to stay in Freddie's bunker or leave when the Hurricane comes down on you, which I'll also explain the consequences of below. To unlock Hurricanes as a weather condition you need to do the following: From that point on, Hurricanes will be a random sporadic weather occurrence. They don't change a huge amount about the game, with the exception that long-distance visibility is lower, and that roads are more slippery when driving. They might also impact any attempt to control flying vehicles (I've yet to test that). To start this questline, you need to go to the unnamed compound on the west side of North Leonard County, near the north of the map. It's actually pretty hard to miss: this is a big facility ringed by electric fences, marked by a sign called "Ripe Pickins Grove", and when you get close, an automated system will blare at you, telling you to leave. There's no given reason for you to ignore this, except, y'know, video game logic. If somebody is telling you not to be somewhere, that's a place worth investigating. To get inside, head to the North section of the compound to see a water tower near the perimeter. You can climb up the tower, then jump down from the walkway over the compound fence to get inside. Once you're in, you need to go to the Bunker at the South side. Be warned though: there are lots of landmines that explode when you get too close. Thankfully they do very little damage, but you can spot them by using Focus mode if you want to be certain. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more You'll also get attacked by drones . These have low health, which is good, but they're small and fairly agile, making them hard to hit. Take time to aim your shots and use focus to hit the propellers to bring them down. Once you reach the bunker, interact with the door to speak to the occupant over the intercom. Though annoyed his defenses failed, he also sees the value in having somebody test them for weaknesses. He tells you he'll text you later when he's upgraded them further so you can try again. For me, that text took 4-7 in-game days, roughly speaking, though it's possible it's tied to something else like mission progression instead of in-game time. Either way, just go and play more GTA 6, and you'll get the message eventually. On your second invitation, the water tower ladder has been blocked off, stopping you from getting past the fence that way. What you want to do instead is go to the Northwest corner of the compound, where you'll find a tractor and a section of fence that's collapsed at the top. If you drive the tractor to the fence and raise the scoop, you can climb up it and leap over the electric wires to get inside. From here, I highly recommend you grab the excavator ahead of you. It's borderline undestroyable and you can simply roll over the mines and have drones bounce off you until you reach the Bunker again. Once you reach it, you'll meet the occupants, including the owner Freddie Gibbs. He's built an apocalypse prepper bunker, but his guests are quickly growing bored and abandon him. He'll give you the tour though, which is when he gets a hurricane warning and the choice about what to do comes up. When Freddie sees the Hurricane, he gives you the chance to either stay in his bunker or leave. There are actually some mildly significant consequences to this choice: Of these two, I'd say it's better to stay. As much as a hit to your GTA 6 relationship status can be a blow, you can always rebuild it with a little patience and care, and the unique car is valuable enough to make it worth it (it also counts as one of Randy's desired cars, as he's after the Benefactor Dubsta that Freddie's is a custom variant of). After this point, no matter your choice, Hurricanes will occur randomly throughout your time spent playing GTA 6 . As mentioned above, they're rare and largely cosmetic impacts on the world, but are still an interesting change to the landscape. © GamesRadar+. Not to be reproduced without permission. sources.text: Catch Port Gellhorn's creepy serial killer and end the 20-year mystery. The GTA 6 Missing Persons case is available as early as Chapter 1, but you'll need access to both Lucia and Jason to wrap up the side quest in Chapter 2. Your stint as a fledgling detective begins in an abandoned warehouse near Mo's shop in Gellhorn, though there are two ways to flag the objective on your map and start the hunt for Gellhorn's serial killer. If you begin in Chapter 1 when you can only play as Jason, head straight to the abandoned warehouse to begin. This is how I began the quest the first time, after following a pack of coyotes through a small opening on the side of the abandoned warehouse. This route gives you an extra text conversation where Jason sends Lucia creepy photos from the warehouse. Begin in Chapter 2 by heading to the Starlet Motel lobby in Gellhorn and inspecting the missing persons posters. Afterward, head to the abandoned warehouse as a couple or go alone, and squeeze through the crawl space. After crawling inside the warehouse, walk to the far end and turn right to enter the glowing red room. Go a little farther to find the, uh, "trophies," and inspect all three lockers, along with the missing persons posters on the wall. This is where you begin your hunt for Gellhorn's three missing tourists. I've got all three locations highlighted below, but if you want to solve it yourself, now is the time to turn back. The first missing person in northwest Gellhorn is in an abandoned trailer—the water tower's shadow is your giveaway. Run along the fence and enter the blue building from the back. There's an awfully suspicious hole in the floor, so pull the remaining floorboards back to discover what's left of Patrick Murray. Call the Kelly County Tip Line after you find Patrick's remains and leave a message. No one will answer the phone, for now. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. The second missing person is in the junkyard, inside the trunk of an old pink DeVanity. The junkyard is right beside Pay 'n' Spray off Gellhorn Ave, across the street from the drive-in theatre. You'll spot Susanne Keeble's pink car with the PRTYGRL license plate while facing the drive-in. After finding a second body, call the tip line again to finally speak to an investigator. They're thrilled to hear there's renewed interest in the case, and ask that you keep in contact should you make any further discoveries. The third missing person is in a U-shaped inlet off the Borrachero Sound. You can find the smaller body of water by traveling southeast from the Wild Hog Point hangar. The view of Wild Hog Point from the tree in the creepy photo is your giveaway, so start looking for a submerged car when you find the right perspective. After finding a third body, the investigator from the tip line asks to meet in the abandoned warehouse. And no, it's not just you, it's a pretty shady proposition. When you're ready for the meeting, consider whether you want to go with your partner or go alone. Both seem to give me the same boost to Jason and Lucia's relationship status, elevating it to Hot Together (4/4) status for the first time in Chapter 2. It had dropped all the way down to Partners in Crime (2/4) just before this, so the Missing Persons quest was a much-appreciated bump. You can also get the serial killer's glasses from his body if you choose to continue as a couple. They're beyond creepy, so I wouldn't blame you if you left them there, but aside from that, there's no cash reward. You will have to do it, though, if you're going for a 100% GTA 6 run. As either Jason or Lucia, return to the abandoned warehouse trophy room and meet Alvan West—the man you spoke to on the Kelly County Tips Line. He's got a 'surprise' waiting for you in the fourth locker, and a fight ensues after checking it out. Going alone means there's no one there to save the passed out Jason or Lucia, and the serial killer takes them to a cave in Lummox County. The attack automatically triggers a character swap, leaving you to investigate your partner's whereabouts after receiving suspicious texts. Enter the abandoned warehouse trophy room just like before while your partner waits outside. When they sense something is off, they'll run inside to save you just as you pass out. After Alvan is dead, inspect his body—you can take his glasses as a souvenir. That's freak behavior, but I'm not judging. We gotta get that 100% cosmetic collection somehow. This Unique Crocodile is larger than others you can find, in addition to being all black. You can find it lurking on an island in the swamp to the South of Hamlet, to the West of Cottonmouth Lake. The croc has several locations it can spawn around the island, but it is only ever on this island. It doesnât move much, so using your Focus to look for a big glowing animal will be easier than checking animal trails. Unlike the crocodiles on this list, the Unique Swamp Alligator likes to move around, making it more awkward to find and put down. Itâs located in Buckskin Swamp and can be found on one of several islands in the center of the swamp. Start your search from the Swamp Meditation Point, and search the six large islands immediately South of it. The Unique Swamp Alligator is covered in swamp weeds, making it stand out from other creatures. One of Bretâs texts will mention a giant Wild Boar found at Wild Hog Point, West of Port Gellhorn. Itâs a pretty distinctive large boar with zebra stripes, a mane, and large tusks. This creature will always spawn North of the airfield, close to the beach, but never on the beach. We found it on the hill overlooking the airfield, napping under a tree. Leaf Links is an island found just Northeast of Vice City, and a large white crocodile has been terrorising the local golfers. The Golf Course Crocodile can be found near the lake water hazard to the Southwest of the golf course. Itâs always wandering the course between the two paths on the Northeast side of the lake. Belpoint Island has a panther problem. The island can be found to the West of Capri. This Unique Panther is purple and can be found anywhere from the edge of the grindset retreat on the South side of the island, and the lone grinder left in a shack on the North side of the island. Itâs a hostile creature, so thereâs a chance it might attack you before you even notice it. After youâve successfully hunted the Unique Panther, Bret will call Jason about a Unique Coyote heâs heard of that is making a nuisance of itself killing domestic cats in the farmland North of Belville. When tracking this creature, the tracks will only come up as âCoyote,â and you wonât be able to study the animal for a unique name. Only after taking it down and picking it up will it be given the âUnique Coyoteâ clarifier. It always hangs around a strip of water directly North of the airstrip North of Belville. Thereâs a dry spot in the center of the long watery ditch, and a group of coyotes usually gather here. One of them will be the Unique Coyote. After you successfully hunt the Unique Coyote, Bret will call once again, this time asking you to find a rare Unique White Fox thatâs in Emerald Springs. It can primarily be found near two small ponds on the West border of Emerald Springs, North of Emerald River. Once you return the Unique White Fox to Bret, heâll reward you with a Karin Rebel truck that you can register as your own.

sources.text: Agent 47 has a new client, and he isn’t usually the type to stay in the shadows. HITMAN World of Assassination’s latest Elusive Target, The Mutiny, stars Lenny Kravitz as Bawma, the magnetic and unpredictable Pirate King of Aleph, first brought to life in 007 First Light . Kravitz lends both his likeness and his voice to the character, who crosses over into the World of Assassination for the first time. The Mutiny Elusive Target mission is available globally on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, ROG Xbox Ally X, ROG Xbox Ally, and PC starting Thursday, November 26, through Thursday, December 24, 2026. From the opening briefing, it’s clear this assignment is unusual. Diana never lets a client brief 47 directly, but Bawma has paid the Agency generously and insists on directing the operation himself. Little is known about the man behind the alias: intelligence suggests he was raised as a child soldier before building Aleph, a sprawling black-market hub in the Western Hemisphere that he calls his kingdom. Now he’s hiding out on Ambrose Island, and 47’s objective is simple: find Bawma, make contact, and await further instructions. Once 47 tracks Bawma down through the island’s ruins and jungles, it soon becomes clear that something far more valuable is at stake. Three of Bawma’s rogue lieutenants stand in the way, and none of them will part with what they’re holding easily. Bawma stays in 47’s ear throughout the mission, and with its bright, upbeat tone and easygoing holiday feel, The Mutiny is one of the most laid-back contracts in the World of Assassination. On Ambrose Island, though, nothing is ever straightforward, and fortune favors the bold. Bold players will want to pay a visit to Madame Serafine. All three targets can be eliminated with a Voodoo Doll: gather the ingredients, add them to the Ritual Bowl, and pick up the doll Madame Serafine creates. Then “kill” the doll to take out its target, whether that means stabbing it with a knife, throwing it in water, shooting it or blowing it up, hitting it with a thrown sharp object, or exposing it to fire or electricity. As with all Elusive Targets, The Mutiny will be removed from the game when it expires on December 24. However, players who own HITMAN World of Assassination or the Ambrose Island location will keep access to The Retaliator, the Arcade version of the mission, as well as its Special Assignment, completely for free. Players who complete The Mutiny with an IOI Account while it’s live will also unlock the Rock Royalty Duck, a regal rubber duck in flashy sunglasses that detonates when it detects nearby motion. sources.title: GTA 6 estaria causando falhas graves no PS5 e Xbox Series; entenda
sources.text: Desde o lançamento de Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ), em 19 de novembro, proprietários de PlayStation 5 e Xbox Series X/S têm relatado problemas técnicos que vão desde travamentos durante as partidas até consoles que deixaram de ligar. Segundo o TalkEsport, um técnico de reparos na Polônia, identificado nas redes sociais como modyfikatorcasper, observou um aumento na quantidade de consoles Xbox encaminhados para manutenção após a estreia do jogo da Rockstar Games . Atualmente, os aparelhos da Microsoft representam dois em cada dez consoles recebidos pela assistência técnica, uma proporção superior à registrada nos meses anteriores, segundo o profissional. Entretanto, ainda não existem evidências conclusivas de que GTA 6 seja diretamente responsável pelos danos aos equipamentos. Entre os principais sintomas compartilhados por usuários nas redes sociais e em fóruns como o Reddit estão: Em um dos casos, um proprietário de Xbox Series X relatou que seu console deixou de ligar na manhã seguinte a uma longa sessão de GTA 6. A suspeita é de uma falha na fonte de alimentação. Outro jogador afirmou que seu equipamento parou de funcionar após apenas dez minutos de jogo. Uma assistência técnica apontou um possível defeito na placa-mãe. Também existem relatos de proprietários de PS5 que passaram a enfrentar travamentos em outros jogos após apresentar problemas durante a execução de GTA 6. A Rockstar disponibilizou uma atualização em 23 de novembro para reduzir travamentos, mas alguns jogadores afirmam que os problemas persistiram. Uma das hipóteses levantadas pelos técnicos é que GTA 6 esteja evidenciando problemas de hardware preexistentes, em vez de provocar diretamente novos defeitos. No caso do PS5, o técnico polonês também identificou problemas relacionados ao vazamento de metal líquido, material utilizado no sistema de dissipação térmica do console. Outro fator que pode explicar o aumento na procura por reparos é a própria popularidade de GTA 6. O lançamento estimulou a utilização de consoles que estavam inativos havia algum tempo, além de aumentar o número de equipamentos em circulação. Dessa forma, o crescimento dos relatos de falhas não significa necessariamente que o jogo esteja operando os consoles além de seus limites técnicos. Embora não exista uma relação comprovada entre o jogo e os danos permanentes aos equipamentos, algumas medidas preventivas podem ajudar a preservar o funcionamento dos consoles: Se o console apresentar cheiro de queimado ou emitir fumaça, interrompa imediatamente o uso e desconecte-o da alimentação elétrica, caso seja seguro fazê-lo. Até a publicação da reportagem do TalkEsport, a Rockstar Games não havia se pronunciado publicamente sobre os relatos de danos permanentes aos consoles. Por enquanto, não há dados suficientes para determinar a dimensão do problema ou estabelecer uma relação direta entre GTA 6 e as falhas de hardware. Amazon Prime também é feito para jogadores! sources.title: GTA 6 dev defends Rockstar after vote against union deal, says it's "best place I've ever worked"
sources.text: "I never worked a minute of overtime that wasn't purely my own decision" Now that GTA 6 is finally here after 13 long years, a good chunk of attention has shifted to developer Rockstar and its workers' recent vote against a union recognition deal – a vote that arguably came as a surprise to many on the outside. There was a 93.2% turnout in the ballot, which commenced in early November, with 1,163 Rockstar employees voting against the deal and 381 voting in favor. These figures add up to a split of 75.3% and 24.7% – numbers that some devs feel make sense. Associate principal vehicle AI programmer Thomas March, for example, is one such dev, taking to LinkedIn to share why he was part of the majority vote himself. "Today, my coworkers and I voted against union recognition at Rockstar North," he writes. "These of course are just my own personal views, but I wanted to add some context for why I did this. The gaming industry has been a terrible and terrifying industry over the past few years, and I can understand why so many people would find this decision confusing." He's not wrong, judging by reactions to the vote – but he feels Rockstar is different. "Rockstar has always been a place that enormously values and rewards individual creativity, and putting a union between the close friendships and relationships with the people that made this all possible was not the right decision," March continues. "It was endlessly frustrating to hear the IWGB [Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain] claim I was being exploited, to see them celebrate the delay of our game and to ridicule the people who make everything I do possible." The dev then explains why he disagrees with the IWGB – which dubbed Rockstar's firing of over 30 employees last year "ruthless" and has repeatedly spoken out against the company's practices. "I've been more taken care of at Rockstar than any place I've ever worked," he says. "Nowhere else have I been listened to so closely, treated with such respect, even while working with veterans and experts bar none." March doesn't end his praise there, saying he "never" had any of his calls "overruled," or any concerns ignored. "I was given absolute freedom and trust to make my contributions to the game the best they could be. And on top of that, the benefits of working here, the healthcare, the allowances, the food and drink and snacks, it has always been astonishing beyond description to see an employer genuinely care for our wellbeing," he goes on. "I never worked a minute of overtime that wasn't purely my own decision and driven by my own passion, and every minute was paid back to me with interest. And no matter what time I left the office, I would see our management all the way to the top leaving later still... and yet they'd thank me for my contributions." With all of this in mind, March says he's saddened to see all of the outrage surrounding Rockstar. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more "It breaks my heart to hear people saying that they don't want to work here, citing headlines that claim crunch, bad working conditions, and exploitation," he concludes. "Rockstar is, by far, the best place I've ever worked. It is not a cautionary tale, it is an exemplary example – not just in making the most incredible and generational games of all time, but also as a workplace." Obviously, though, this is one voice of many. Former devs have shared different views in the past, with some instructing fans to not boycott GTA 6 but rather "support our legal battle instead" and "win justice for the people who helped make" the game but faced dismissal before it could release. Animation programmer Nestor Uriarte also said he's "worried about getting laid off" even after "working on the biggest game of all time" – you know, Grand Theft Auto 6. Others outside of the studio have also expressed fears over more layoffs now that the new Grand Theft Auto is here. Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 writer Jennifer Svedberg-Yen is one such dev. She hoped that the GTA 6 devs would be "successful in unionizing." Finance experts like Square Enix veteran Jacob Novak also stated the game's success indeed isn't enough to stop layoffs . That's all just to say that March's stance – while completely valid – isn't the only one out there. That's the whole point of a vote, I suppose, and his take (while not the sole POV out there) provides a bit of insight perhaps on why it swayed the way it did. Have a look at our GTA 6 review to learn how we feel about one of the biggest new games this year, or check our GTA 6 guide for more about Rockstar's behemoth release. sources.title: Por que GTA 6 não permite repetir missões? Rockstar explica decisão
sources.text: Entre as mudanças introduzidas em Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ), uma delas pode frustrar os fãs da franquia: a ausência de uma opção para repetir missões da campanha. Diferentemente de GTA 5 , o novo título da Rockstar Games não permite revisitar missões concluídas por meio de um sistema dedicado, seja para reviver momentos marcantes da história ou melhorar o desempenho em determinados objetivos. Em entrevista ao Kotaku, Scott Butchard, diretor sênior de design da Rockstar, explicou que a decisão está diretamente relacionada à proposta narrativa do jogo. Segundo Butchard, a possibilidade de repetir missões chegou a ser considerada durante as primeiras etapas de desenvolvimento. Entretanto, conforme o projeto avançava, a equipe percebeu que a funcionalidade não combinava com a experiência que pretendia oferecer. “À medida que o jogo tomava forma, o recurso parecia entrar em conflito com a história que estávamos tentando contar, além de parecer estranho e desconectado”, afirmou o diretor, em tradução livre. Na avaliação da desenvolvedora, permitir que os jogadores revisitassem missões isoladamente diminuiria a importância das decisões tomadas ao longo da campanha. A abordagem aproxima GTA 6 de experiências narrativas nas quais as consequências das ações do jogador são mais importantes do que a busca por um desempenho perfeito em cada missão. Embora tenha se popularizado em GTA 5, a possibilidade de repetir missões não esteve presente desde o início da franquia. A funcionalidade foi introduzida em The Ballad of Gay Tony, expansão de GTA 4, e posteriormente incorporada a GTA 5. No quinto título numerado da série, o recurso estava associado a um sistema de medalhas que avaliava o desempenho dos jogadores com base no cumprimento de objetivos secundários. Isso incentivava os fãs a revisitar missões para conquistar medalhas de ouro, experimentar diferentes abordagens ou simplesmente reviver seus momentos favoritos da campanha. Até o momento, a Rockstar Games não anunciou planos para implementar um sistema de repetição de missões em GTA 6. A decisão reforça a prioridade dada pela desenvolvedora à imersão narrativa, uma característica também presente em Red Dead Redemption 2 . Por outro lado, a ausência da funcionalidade limita as possibilidades para jogadores interessados em revisitar momentos específicos da história sem precisar recorrer a salvamentos anteriores ou iniciar uma nova campanha. Uma eventual implementação por meio de modificações feitas pela comunidade, quando o jogo chegar ao PC, também é uma possibilidade, embora não exista confirmação nesse sentido. sources.text: Desde seu lançamento, os fãs de Grand Theft Auto 6 não param de procurar e encontrar lugares inusitados, situações bizarras e easter eggs de tudo que é possível, incluindo referências a outros jogos e personagens da Rockstar. sources.title: Brainwashing Easter egg walkthrough in GTA 6
sources.text: The brainwashing Easter egg in Grand Theft Auto 6 is a long side mission in which you get the chance to investigate long-forgotten bunkers where a certain president spent some time (and listened to rumba) and where brainwashing experiments had taken place. Like the Vice City portal Easter egg , you'll need to go through a series of steps to finish this mission, but there's no other option if you want to learn the truth about what the government hid from you. To help you uncover the mystery regarding President Russo, here's how to start the 'Kill The President' Easter egg in GTA 6 and how to complete it. To start the "Kill the President" quest chain, you must talk to José Bermúdez , a man sitting in front of the Joe Russo monument in Downtown , Vice City. Be sure to visit him during the day ! Choose to ask "What really happened?" after he starts talking. José will tell you to visit his apartment in a salmon-colored building with Cuban flags on Little Cuba NW 4th avenue if you want to know the truth. Go to his place to find the blueprint of a bunker on the wall, some recordings, and a picture showing President Russo on Sharktooth Island — your next destination. Before you go, be sure to listen to the recording and pay attention to what President Russo says, as he'll tell you the code for the next area. Travel northeast on the map to find Sharktooth Island, on the southern side of Little Hardin Island in Leonard County . Once you reach the island, head northwest to find the bunker entrance and a keypad lock that requires a six-digit number. Unfortunately, you won't find the code on the island. The information you need to figure out the code was shared by President Russo himself in the recording you found in José's apartment . Now, if you don't want to return to the apartment just to listen to the recording again, don't worry. The code to open the bunker is 010317 . As you enter the bunk, turn right to find an electrical box. Pull the lever up to turn the lights on, then head in the opposite direction. After passing through a couple of small rooms, you will get to a larger room where you'll find some beds and a presidential desk beside a large safe. Sit in the chair behind the desk and look to your right for the "Search drawer" option to appear. Next, pick up the phone. Inside the drawer, you will find a file with three different number sequences listed below the word "Protocol." Keep these in mind. The next step is to return to one of the first rooms you passed through and listen to the recordings , in which someone mentions the number "5297" and "protocol two." These are the clues you need to open the safe. If you want a quick answer to how to open the safe in the presidential bunker, you need to move the last number to the front to get the safe code, which is 2975. Inside, you will find Russo's 1922 pistol and a photo . It appears to show part of the map with arrows pointing to a specific location. If you flip it , you can read the word "OBSESS" on the back of the photo. Now, it's time to locate the place in the photo. The photo you found inside the safe in the presidential bunker shows the location of another bunker in Grassrivers, Mariana County . You can reach it by heading southwest from the Richardson Hunting Supplies shop , but you can't enter through the main entrance. Instead, you will need to open the hatch , which you find to the northeast . As expected of a secret bunker, the hatch is locked, and you will need to enter a six-digit number to open it. Luckily, you've opened the safe in the presidential bunker and seen the word behind the photo . Don't you think some letters look like numbers? If you make the numbers out, you'll get 085355 . Once you're inside the bunker, there isn't much to do besides make your way through the rooms on the left side to reach the electrical box and turn on the lights. Next, return to the starting portion of the area and follow the path through the rooms on the right side until you reach a half-open metal door leading to a control room. Press the two red buttons on the main panel. The lights on the garage will turn on, and the door to your right will open. You can now enter the garage, where you will find a tank, the Cold War 556 unique assault rifle , some ammo and grenades. From this point on, the main entrance will remain open, so you can use it if you return here whenever you'd like. Enjoy the rewards, but this quest is far from over. Return to the main area of the bunker and look for the first room on the right side , where there's a chair and a TV that's now turned on . Sit on the chair , and you will be transported to the past and the game's perspective changes to a first-person view. While in this dimension, you will be trapped in a loop that only allows you to move forward through the corridor . To return to a previous room, you will need to circle all the way back. The first step is to leave the room and follow the main corridor until you loop back to where you started. Enter the room where you woke up and answer the phone . The voice on the other end will mention that patients have become obsessed with time and that maybe they should get rid of the clock . Following this clue will lead to the reception area , the only place where you'll find a clock. On the right side of the room, there's a locked door that requires a six-digit number to open. Ignore it for now, because you don't have enough information to discover the code yet. Interact with the clock to time travel to the future, where you'll find a run-down version of the institute. Take another walk around until you reach the corridor before the reception area . A telephone will ring. Jump through the broken window to enter the room and answer the phone. Pay attention to what the scientist says about the three candidates. Take another lap until you reach the corridor with the candidates' room , where there are multiple beds . sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI A comunidade de modders continua avançando na tentativa de fazer GTA 6 funcionar no PC. Depois que o vazador CyberLeek compartilhou o executável da versão de Xbox nas redes sociais , diferentes grupos começaram a desenvolver adaptações não oficiais do jogo para computadores. Agora, uma dessas iniciativas ganhou seu primeiro lançamento público: o ScarlettPort. A ferramenta permite executar uma versão adaptada de GTA 6 sem precisar compilar arquivos manualmente, bastando baixar e iniciar o pacote disponibilizado pelos responsáveis pelo projeto. A versão mais recente já consegue passar pelos menus, telas de salvamento e avisos legais até carregar o mundo do jogo. O processo leva cerca de 178 segundos na versão 0.5.0, que também permite controlar o personagem e visualizar cenários com iluminação e texturas completas. O ScarlettPort é um projeto que busca adaptar a versão de Xbox de GTA 6 para funcionar em computadores. Diferentemente de outras iniciativas da comunidade, a ferramenta já pode ser baixada em um arquivo ZIP e executada sem que o usuário precise compilar o código por conta própria. A atualização 0.5.2 trouxe uma série de correções para melhorar a inicialização e o funcionamento do jogo. Entre as mudanças está a solução para uma tela preta que podia aparecer depois do carregamento com a predefinição Estável, além do uso do próprio upscaler de GTA 6 quando a tecnologia da AMD não está disponível. O projeto também recebeu melhorias no carregamento de cenários e nos shaders, incluindo a restauração de 40 variantes e correções que evitam falhas durante a compilação de determinados pipelines. Em testes realizados com uma AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT, o ScarlettPort apresentou uma taxa de quadros mediana entre 18,9 e 22 FPS. Outras novidades do port também incluem suporte aprimorado a mouse e teclado, controles DualSense e DualShock 4, além de registros de erros mais detalhados. O inicializador também passou a exibir o progresso da compilação de shaders em tempo real e permite instalar novas versões com apenas um clique. Vale lembrar que a ferramenta não inclui os arquivos do jogo e exige uma cópia da versão de Xbox Series X. Enquanto o ScarlettPort avança com seu lançamento público, outro projeto acompanhado pela comunidade também chama atenção. O CGBJ, que já alcançou 91,5% de conclusão segundo os critérios do site PortWatchVI , conseguiu executar uma versão de GTA 6 com vários jogadores no mesmo mundo. Vídeos compartilhados nas redes sociais mostram personagens e veículos circulando juntos, além de um sistema de comunicação por proximidade. A iniciativa chamou atenção porque, há poucos dias, os projetos ainda enfrentavam dificuldades para fazer o jogo funcionar de maneira básica nos computadores. Em publicação, os responsáveis pelo feito destacaram que conseguiram colocar o multiplayer em funcionamento antes mesmo da chegada do GTA Online 2 . Lembrando que o projeto ainda é não oficial e não representa uma versão completa do modo online da Rockstar, mas mostra outro caminho explorado pelos modders. Apesar dos avanços, é importante manter as expectativas sob controle. O ScarlettPort ainda está longe de oferecer uma experiência estável a 30 FPS: os testes divulgados apontam desempenho próximo de 20 FPS, com limitações que ainda precisam ser corrigidas. Mesmo assim, é o primeiro lançamento público de uma adaptação não oficial do jogo para PC. Também é preciso ter cuidado com supostos downloads de GTA 6 para computadores em sites de torrent. Existem versões falsas circulando nessas plataformas, que podem esconder arquivos maliciosos ou não entregar o conteúdo prometido. Por enquanto, o ScarlettPort é uma das alternativas públicas disponíveis, mas exige uma cópia legítima da versão de Xbox Series X para funcionar. sources.text: A Black Friday 2026 acontece nesta sexta (27) e traz oportunidades para quem deseja investir em um notebook gamer sem comprometer todo o orçamento. Já que existem inúmeras configurações e faixas de preço no mercado, encontrar um modelo que ofereça bom desempenho exige atenção especial a alguns detalhes. No entanto, nem sempre o equipamento mais caro ou com os componentes mais recentes é a melhor escolha. Para economizar, é importante considerar quais jogos você pretende rodar, o equilíbrio entre as peças e até mesmo a possibilidade de atualizar o notebook no futuro. Para ajudar nessa decisão, Vinícius Francioni, coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Produtos da Avell, fabricante brasileira de notebooks de alta performance, reuniu cinco recomendações para orientar os leitores do VOXL durante as compras desta sexta (27). Confira abaixo o que avaliar antes de aproveitar as ofertas. A placa de vídeo (ou GPU) é um dos componentes mais importantes de um notebook gamer — mas isso não significa que você precise investir no modelo mais potente do mercado. Antes de comprar, vale conferir os requisitos recomendados dos jogos que pretende jogar e identificar qual GPU atende às suas necessidades. Outro detalhe importante é observar o TGP (Total Graphics Power), indicador da potência disponibilizada para a placa de vídeo. Dois notebooks com a mesma GPU podem apresentar desempenhos diferentes dependendo desse valor e da capacidade de refrigeração de cada equipamento. “Dois notebooks equipados com o mesmo modelo de placa de vídeo não necessariamente entregam o mesmo desempenho”, explica Francioni. Segundo o especialista, a potência do componente e a capacidade de dissipação de calor influenciam diretamente o resultado. Por isso, não compare os equipamentos apenas pelo nome da placa de vídeo. Verifique as especificações completas e procure avaliações técnicas para entender como aquele modelo se comporta durante os jogos que você pretende executar. O processador também merece atenção na hora de escolher um notebook gamer, já que é responsável por executar tarefas relacionadas à lógica dos jogos, simulações e outras operações do sistema. Entretanto, nem sempre vale gastar mais para adquirir a CPU mais potente disponível. “O consumidor não precisa, necessariamente, investir no processador mais potente disponível no mercado”, orienta Francioni. Dependendo dos jogos e da resolução utilizada, direcionar uma parte maior do orçamento para a placa de vídeo pode proporcionar um ganho de desempenho mais perceptível. Já na memória RAM, o “terror” dos componentes de PC atualmente, 16 GB representam um ponto de partida adequado para muitos jogos atuais — enquanto 32 GB podem beneficiar quem utiliza títulos mais exigentes ou mantém outros programas abertos simultaneamente. Também vale conferir a capacidade do SSD, já que alguns lançamentos ocupam mais de 100 GB, e verificar se o equipamento abre espaço e suporte para ampliar esses componentes futuramente. O sistema de refrigeração é outro aspecto que não deve ser ignorado. Durante sessões prolongadas de jogos, componentes de alto desempenho geram bastante calor e, quando a dissipação é insuficiente, o notebook pode reduzir sua frequência de operação para controlar a temperatura — o que consequentemente prejudica o desempenho. A tela também precisa combinar com a configuração do equipamento. Modelos com taxas de atualização de 165 Hz ou 300 Hz podem oferecer imagens mais fluidas, mas é importante que a placa de vídeo consiga entregar uma quantidade de quadros compatível com esses números. Por fim, avalie o custo-benefício para além do desconto anunciado. Consulte o histórico de preços, compare as condições de pagamento e confira o período de garantia e a disponibilidade de assistência técnica. Como destaca Francioni, a possibilidade de ampliar componentes e contar com suporte pode prolongar a vida útil do notebook. Antes de fechar a compra, portanto, compare diferentes modelos e considere quanto tempo pretende utilizar o equipamento. Um desconto elevado nem sempre representa o melhor negócio se a configuração não atender às suas necessidades ou limitar futuras atualizações. sources.text: Hoje, sexta-feira (27), é Black Friday , e quem procura um notebook gamer encontra variedade de configurações e de faixas de preço, além dos descontos . Só que o percentual na etiqueta não deveria ser o primeiro critério da compra. Nem sempre o equipamento mais caro, ou com os componentes mais recentes, é o mais adequado. O perfil de uso, a compatibilidade com os jogos e a possibilidade de atualizações futuras pesam tanto quanto o preço. Para ajudar nessa decisão, Vinícius Francioni, coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Produtos da Avell, fabricante brasileira de notebooks de alta performance, reuniu cinco recomendações. Antes de investir, vale consultar os requisitos recomendados dos jogos que você pretende rodar. Títulos competitivos podem apresentar demandas gráficas diferentes das de jogos de mundo aberto. Além do modelo da placa de vídeo (GPU), é preciso olhar a potência gráfica, identificada pela sigla TGP (Total Graphics Power). Francioni explica por quê: “Dois notebooks equipados com o mesmo modelo de placa de vídeo não necessariamente entregam o mesmo desempenho. A potência disponibilizada para esse componente e a capacidade de dissipação de calor do equipamento influenciam diretamente sua performance. Por isso, comparar apenas o nome da GPU pode levar a uma avaliação equivocada.” A GPU cuida principalmente do processamento gráfico. Já o processador (CPU) executa a lógica dos jogos, as simulações e outras operações do sistema. Isso não significa que você precisa do processador mais potente do mercado. Segundo Francioni, dependendo dos jogos e da resolução utilizada, destinar uma parcela maior do orçamento à placa de vídeo pode render um ganho de desempenho mais perceptível. “O importante é buscar uma configuração equilibrada e adequada ao perfil de uso”, orienta o especialista. Para muitos jogos atuais, 16 GB de memória RAM são um ponto de partida adequado. Os 32 GB podem beneficiar quem joga títulos mais exigentes ou usa outros programas ao mesmo tempo. O armazenamento também merece atenção: alguns jogos ocupam mais de 100 GB, então a capacidade do SSD faz diferença. Conferir se o notebook permite ampliar memória e armazenamento ajuda a distribuir o investimento ao longo do tempo. Em sessões prolongadas, componentes de alto desempenho geram calor. Se a refrigeração for insuficiente, o equipamento pode reduzir a frequência de operação dos componentes para controlar a temperatura, o que compromete o desempenho. A tela entra na conta da mesma forma. Painéis de 165 Hz ou 300 Hz proporcionam mais fluidez, desde que o hardware entregue taxas de quadros compatíveis. Consultar avaliações técnicas independentes ajuda a identificar diferenças entre equipamentos com especificações semelhantes. Além de consultar o histórico de preços e as condições de pagamento, considere o período de garantia, a disponibilidade de assistência técnica e as condições para futuras atualizações. “Um notebook gamer é um investimento que precisa ser avaliado a longo prazo. A possibilidade de ampliar determinados componentes e contar com suporte técnico pode prolongar a vida útil do equipamento. Uma boa compra não é necessariamente aquela que apresenta o maior desconto, mas a que atende às necessidades do usuário pelo maior tempo possível”, conclui Francioni.
